item.title: Time Is a Factor: The Value of Contacting an Attorney Early
item.description: After an accident, a dispute, or a sudden legal problem, many people hesitate before contacting an attorney. Some want to wait and see how things unfold. Others assume they can handle the early stages themselves and bring in legal help later if things get complicated. That instinct is understandable, but it often overlooks how much happens behind the scenes in the early days of a legal matter. Timing plays a larger role than most people realize.
